title: NBN POI 3FSR (Footscray), 3STK (St Kilda) Card replacement
current_summary: Planned card-replacement maintenance at Footscray (3FSR) and St Kilda (3STK) POIs has been completed. Services were reported restored at 2026-08-04T20:00:00Z (2026-08-05 06:00:00 AEST).

updates.content: We will be supporting planned work by an upstream network provider that may impact NBN services connected via the Footscray (3FSR) and St Kilda (3STK) POIs in VIC. The maintenance window is Wednesday, 5 August 2026, from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST. During this time, some customers may experience one or more interruptions, with potential downtime of up to six hours within the window. No action is required—services should restore automatically once the work is complete. We will monitor progress and provide updates if anything changes. Thank you for your patience.

The planned maintenance (card replacement at Footscray (3FSR) and St Kilda (3STK) POIs) has been completed. The provider reported the maintenance finished and services were restored at 2026-08-04T20:00:00Z (2026-08-05 06:00:00 AEST).
